lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Eight visible vertical white lines of varying intensity; spacing is irregular with the widest inter-line gaps located in the central torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line and the three anterior-most lines are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank and failing to bridge the distance between the dorsal crest and ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of two distinct circular white spots is located on the posterior flank, superior to the hind-limb junction.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate trajectory, initiating with a posterior-lateral sweep from the pedicles, transitioning to a medial inward curve, and terminating in a superior-posterior orientation.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 3.8 times the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tips occupy approximately 18% of the total vertical silhouette length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a singular white spot on the sub-ocular region of the cheek; sharp color transition to yellow-ochre on the lower extremities; prominent white dorsal mane extending from the nuchal region to the mid-lumbar section.
